allow: PowerShell($ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $gh = \(Get-Command gh\).Source; if \($gh\) { & $gh run list --limit 3 } else { "gh CLI not installed" })

PowerShell(foreach \($p in 18188,16368,26768,32408\) { $proc = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $p" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($proc\) { "{0} | {1} | {2}" -f $p, $proc.Name, $proc.CommandLine.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(120, $proc.CommandLine.Length\)\) } else { "$p | not found" } })

PowerShell(foreach \($p in 18188,16368,26768\) { try { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -ErrorAction Stop; "killed $p" } catch { "could not kill ${p}: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; "--- remaining on 3000-3004 ---"; netstat -ano | Select-String "LISTENING" | Select-String ":300[0-4]")
